description: Return the latest stored macroeconomic value for every available indicator in one currency, as a compact current macro snapshot. An unverified announcement_datetime has unproven origin; it is neither a verified scheduled time nor observed actual publication. Report absent schedule, publication and ingestion evidence as unknown, and latency as not measured. Access: USD keyless; others: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

currency.description: 3-letter ISO currency code (case-insensitive). Required for the latest view.

payload.description: changes only: compact (default) or full rows.

since.description: changes only: previous next_cursor, ISO 8601 time or epoch seconds.

view.description: latest (default): newest value per indicator for `currency`. changes: a resumable feed of newly ingested announcements across currencies; pass the returned next_cursor back as `since`.

name: latest_announcements
title: Latest Macro Announcements
